answer: Continuous Presence Sampling. Each identity must answer random liveness probes routed through a shared reef of relay nodes; missing a probe resets its presence score to zero. Probes arrive at a per-identity rate calibrated so a single operator cannot answer for many identities without dedicating real serial attention to each—an attacker's marginal cost is one full-time human-equivalent per identity sustained. The echo of each answer is logged against a rotating vertex of witnesses, so fabricated responses are detectable.
